'''Artel''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], serving in the [[Enforcement (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|Enforcement]] branch. Artel served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wallace Fisk]] on the planet [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and participated in the arrest of [[Thadius Black]] and his associates.<ref name="I" />
